node.statement: By the extended d-inclusion inequalities, ||v_n(I_n tensor A_j)||<=(1+d)||A_j|| and ||g_n(I_n tensor B_j,X)||<=d||B_j||||X||. The product bound in the extended epsilon-C*-algebra and sum_j||A_j||||B_j||=1 therefore give ||w_prime_n(X)||<=(1+epsilon)(1+d)d||X||. The involution is isometric, so the same holds for w_doubleprime_n; hence ||I_n tensor w||<=2d for d+epsilon<=1/4. Thus one may take C_w=2 uniformly in n and B.
